d:
Israel heads into a high-stakes election on October 27, with Netanyahu facing a challenge from former military chief Gadi Eisenkot and a divided opposition hoping to end his grip on power.
Final opinion polls put Netanyahu's governing bloc behind the opposition but there's a catch. Neither side is projected to win the 61 seats needed to form a majority government.
And even if Netanyahu loses ground, his opponents face a battle of their own. Deep political divisions and the role of Arab parties could turn the race to form a government into a political minefield.
